title: Everyone’s Talking About the ‘Blue Tsunami.’ In Japan, It’s Complicated.
summary_full: The New York Post used a Hokusai work to depict Donald Trump being swept away by Democrats’ midterm election win. Some in Japan were bothered by the imagery.
